assets.subject: Bulwark starter spear
assets.prompt: Using the supplied ORIGINAL Whetstorm Bulwark spear concept as the design reference, make a new square inventory ITEM ICON. Dark slate-blue painted background edge to edge with subtle warm upper-left light. Hand-painted stylized fantasy, bold clean simplified forms, slightly oversized weapon, restrained detail, clear material separation. No border, no frame, no text, no letters, no logo, no people, no hands, no glow or magic. This is a 2D item picture, not a picture on white. Keep the weapon consistent with the supplied concept, and do not imitate any other game's art.
